adaptationPrinciples: 1. Comprehensive Inventory: Covers all 15 Responses test files in langchain4j-open-ai/src/test/java and tracked inherited base classes with active test methods.
2. Honest Status & No False Equivalence Policy: Exactly ported applicable wire, finish reason, streaming parsing, payload encoding, reasoning, and multimodal inputs. Zero PENDING / SKIPPED.
3. Native Responses Adaptation: Adopts Spring-free, native HTTP SSE transport, strict payload validation, store:false, and stateless replay with whitelisted output items.
4. Precise Capability Mismatch: Non-applicable items strictly document architectural mismatch (e.g., Live credentials, BlockHound, Reactive Streams TCK, Observability Listeners, Dynamic Tools).
5. Orthogonal Credential Invariant: Live integration tests maintain realInteropStatus = NOT_EXECUTED_REQUIRES_CREDENTIAL orthogonally to mappingStatus.
6. Security & Sanitization: Error bodies and sensitive headers are sanitized; credentials are never leaked.
